title: Teaching
subtitle: Create, publish and track your courses.

status.title: Course status
status.ready: Everything is in place. You can submit this course for review.
status.missingIntro_one: {{count}} thing left to fix before you can submit:
status.missingIntro_other: {{count}} things left to fix before you can submit:
status.pendingMessage: An admin is reviewing this course. You can't edit it meanwhile; withdraw it if you need to make changes.
status.publishedMessage: This course is live. Students can find it, buy it and learn from it.
status.archivedMessage: This course is hidden from the catalog and search. Students who already bought it can still learn.

empty.title: No courses yet
empty.message: Create your first course, add lessons and send it for review.
empty.filteredMessage: You have no courses with the status "{{status}}".

cover.label: Cover image
cover.hint: PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB. 16:9 looks best.
cover.sizeError: This image is too large (max 5 MB).
cover.typeError: Only PNG or JPG images are supported.

benefits.label: What students will learn
benefits.placeholder: e.g. Build a REST API from scratch

edit.title: Course info
edit.created: Draft created. Now add the lessons.

fields.title: Title
fields.tagsHelper: Pick up to 5 from the available tags.
fields.subtitle: Subtitle
fields.subtitlePlaceholder: One line that sells the course
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: What the course covers, who it is for, what students need
fields.descriptionHelper: {{count}} characters. At least {{min}} are needed to submit.

pending.title: Locked while in review
pending.message: An admin is reviewing this course. Withdraw it from the status screen to edit it.

archived.title: Hidden course
archived.message: Make the course visible again from the status screen before editing it.

published.title: This course is published
published.message: Subtitle, description, learning points, project and cover save right away. Title, category, tags, price and the curriculum need a revision that an admin approves.
published.revisionMessage: Title, category, tags and price are saved in the revision and go live only after approval. Subtitle, description, learning points, project and cover still apply immediately.
published.pendingMessage: Title, category, tags and price are locked until the admin decides. The other fields still save right away.

revision.title: Revision
revision.created: Revision created. Edit the major fields now.
revision.noneMessage: To change the title, price, category, tags or the curriculum of a published course, create a revision. Students keep seeing the current version until it is approved.
revision.pendingMessage: An admin is reviewing your revision. Students still see the published version.
revision.ready: The revision is complete and can be submitted.

validation.titleMax: Title can have at most {{count}} characters.
validation.subtitleMax: Subtitle can have at most {{count}} characters.
validation.descriptionMax: Description can have at most {{count}} characters.
validation.tagsMax: You can pick at most {{count}} tags.
validation.projectMax: The project can have at most {{count}} characters.
validation.lessonTitleMax: Title can have at most {{count}} characters.
validation.lessonContentMax: Notes can have at most {{count}} characters.
validation.sectionTitleMax: Title can have at most {{count}} characters.
validation.topicMin: Describe the topic in at least {{count}} characters.
validation.topicMax: The topic can have at most {{count}} characters.

unsaved.title: Discard changes?
unsaved.message: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now they will be lost.

missing.TITLE_LENGTH: The title must be 5 to 120 characters.
missing.DESCRIPTION_TOO_SHORT: The description needs at least 100 characters.
missing.NOT_ENOUGH_LESSONS: Add at least 3 lessons in total.
missing.LESSON_VIDEO_INVALID: Lesson {{number}} needs a valid YouTube link.
missing.LESSON_DURATION_INVALID: Lesson {{number}} needs a length between 1 second and 6 hours.
missing.PREVIEW_COUNT: Mark 1 to 3 lessons as free previews.
missing.PRICE_INVALID: The price must be free or between $0.99 and $999.99.
missing.ORIGINAL_PRICE_INVALID: The original price must be higher than the price.

history.title: Review history
history.empty: Nothing yet. Submit the course to start the review.

curriculum.title: Curriculum

empty.title: No sections yet
empty.message: Start with a section, then add lessons with a YouTube link.

curriculum.maxSections: A course can have at most {{max}} sections.
curriculum.maxLessons: A course can have at most {{max}} lessons.
curriculum.revisionMessage: Changes stay on this screen until you tap "Save revision". Students keep the published curriculum until an admin approves it.
curriculum.needsRevisionTitle: Create a revision to edit the curriculum
curriculum.needsRevisionMessage: This course is published, so its sections and lessons change through a revision that an admin approves.
curriculum.lockedMessage: The course or its revision is in review, or the course is hidden. Withdraw it or make it visible first.

section.title: Section title
section.deleteConfirmMessage: "{{title}}" and all its lessons will be removed.

lesson.title: Lesson title
lesson.durationHelper: For example 12:34, or 1:02:05 for over an hour.
lesson.previewLimit: A course can have at most {{max}} free previews.
lesson.contentHelper: Optional. The AI features use these notes.

withdraw.title: Withdraw from review?
withdraw.message: The course goes back to draft and you can edit it again.

archive.title: Hide this course?
archive.message: It disappears from the catalog and search. Students who already bought it keep access.

discardRevision.title: Discard the revision?
discardRevision.message: All changes in the revision are lost. The published course is not touched.

withdrawRevision.title: Withdraw the revision?
withdrawRevision.message: The revision is removed from review and deleted. The published course is not touched.

delete.title: Delete this course?
delete.message: The course and its lessons are deleted for good. This can't be undone.

toast.withdrawn: Withdrawn. The course is a draft again.

ai.title: AI course draft
ai.intro: Tell the AI what the course is about. It suggests a subtitle, description, learning points and an outline. Nothing is saved until you apply a part and save the course.
ai.loading: The AI is writing your draft. This can take a few seconds.
ai.appliedToast: Added to the form. Review it, then save.
ai.outlineNeedsDraft: The outline can only be applied to a draft or rejected course.
ai.outlineNeedsCourse: Save the course first, then apply the outline from its editor.

outlineConfirm.title: Create the sections?
outlineConfirm.message: {{count}} sections will be added to the curriculum. Their lessons appear as "planned" rows: you add the YouTube link and the length.

ai.outlineApplied: Sections created. Fill in the planned lessons.
